template_name: Highway EPC – UK Smart Motorway / All-Purpose Trunk Road Upgrade

tasks.title: Scheme identification & strategic need case
tasks.description: Define the transport problem, strategic need and scheme objectives for the SRN corridor and draft the Strategic Outline Statement.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Need case documented and endorsed by the sponsor.

tasks.title: Stakeholder mapping & engagement strategy
tasks.description: Identify stakeholders (National Highways, local authorities, undertakers, communities, MPs) and define an engagement strategy.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stakeholder map approved and engagement plan baselined.

tasks.title: Outline funding envelope & initial business case
tasks.description: Prepare the initial outline business case and funding envelope aligned to the Project Control Framework.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Funding envelope endorsed by the sponsor.

tasks.title: Route corridor definition & study area
tasks.description: Define the route corridor and environmental/traffic study area and confirm the scheme extents.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Corridor and study area agreed with National Highways.

tasks.title: Baseline traffic data collection scope
tasks.description: Define the scope and locations for baseline traffic data collection to feed forecasting and economic appraisal.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scope approved by the traffic and economics team.

tasks.title: EPC contract & delivery model framing
tasks.description: Frame the delivery model (DBFO/DPR/EPC) and outline the contractual and risk-allocation approach.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Preferred delivery model endorsed by the sponsor.

tasks.title: Environmental constraints desk study
tasks.description: Compile a desk-based constraints study (ecology, heritage, flooding, land use) to initiate the constraints register.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Constraints register initiated and accepted.

tasks.title: DMRB Stage 1 strategic assessment
tasks.description: Confirm DMRB Stage 1 entry criteria and record the strategic assessment basis.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stage 1 entry criteria met and logged.

tasks.title: Programme risk framework & risk register set-up
tasks.description: Establish the risk-management framework and populate the initial risk register with categories, owners and scores.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Register live with top risks logged and owned.

tasks.title: CDM 2015 duty-holder appointments
tasks.description: Make CDM 2015 appointments (Client, Principal Designer, Principal Contractor) and record them.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All CDM duty-holders appointed and notified as required.

tasks.title: Document control & CDE (BIM) framework
tasks.description: Set up the common data environment (CDE), Exchange Information Requirements (EIR) and document-control procedures.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Common Data Environment configured and EIR issued.

tasks.title: Initial programme master schedule outline
tasks.description: Develop the high-level master schedule with phase milestones and logic.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: High-level milestones baselined.

tasks.title: Traffic data collection & baseline surveys
tasks.description: Execute baseline traffic-data collection (counts, journey times, origin-destination) and validate the dataset.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Data validated and accepted for modelling.

tasks.title: Option assessment (DMRB Stage 2)
tasks.description: Carry out DMRB Stage 2 option assessment across transport, environmental, engineering and cost criteria.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Options appraised and recommendation endorsed.

tasks.title: Route options development (online/offline)
tasks.description: Develop route options (online widening, offline, junction layouts) for assessment.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Options meet the design intent and are assessable.

tasks.title: Preliminary traffic forecasting & economic appraisal
tasks.description: Build the traffic model and produce the economic appraisal and benefit-cost ratio.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: BCR above threshold and appraisal accepted.

tasks.title: Ground investigation (GI) scope & desk study
tasks.description: Define the GI scope and complete the geotechnical desk study to de-risk ground conditions.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scope tender-ready and desk study accepted.

tasks.title: Environmental scoping report (EIA screening)
tasks.description: Prepare the EIA scoping report and obtain the scoping opinion.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scoping opinion received from the determining authority.

tasks.title: Public consultation strategy & non-statutory consultation
tasks.description: Plan and run non-statutory public consultation and report feedback.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Non-statutory consultation completed and feedback report published.

tasks.title: Option costing & value engineering
tasks.description: Produce option cost estimates and run value-engineering workshops.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Estimates within the funding envelope and accepted.

tasks.title: Planning & consent route determination (DCO/TWAO)
tasks.description: Determine the consenting route (DCO for NSIP, TWAO, or Town & Country Planning) for the scheme.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Consent route confirmed and documented.

tasks.title: Sustainability & carbon assessment outline
tasks.description: Establish the carbon baseline and sustainability targets for the scheme.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Baseline carbon assessed and targets set.

tasks.title: Preferred route announcement preparation
tasks.description: Prepare the Preferred Route Announcement (PRA) pack for ministerial/sponsor endorsement.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: PRA pack ready and cleared for announcement.

tasks.title: Stage 2 report & preferred option recommendation
tasks.description: Consolidate the DMRB Stage 2 report and recommend the preferred option for endorsement.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Preferred option endorsed by the sponsor.

tasks.title: DMRB Stage 3 scheme assessment
tasks.description: Complete the DMRB Stage 3 scheme assessment to support the fixed preliminary design.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scheme assessment accepted by National Highways.

tasks.title: Preliminary design – horizontal & vertical alignment
tasks.description: Develop the preliminary horizontal and vertical alignment and fix the design for consent.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Alignment frozen and accepted for detailed design.

tasks.title: Pavement assessment & outline pavement design
tasks.description: Assess pavement options and prepare the outline pavement design.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pavement strategy agreed for detailed design.

tasks.title: Structures feasibility – overbridge/underbridge replacement
tasks.description: Assess structures (overbridges, underbridges, retaining walls) and select feasible structural forms.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Feasible structural forms selected and accepted.

tasks.title: Drainage strategy compliant with CD 527
tasks.description: Develop the drainage strategy and SuDS approach compliant with CD 527.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Strategy demonstrably meets CD 527.

tasks.title: Geotechnical design basis & ground model
tasks.description: Develop the geotechnical ground model and design basis from GI and desk study.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ground model accepted by the design team.

tasks.title: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) chapters
tasks.description: Draft the EIA chapters (air, noise, ecology, landscape, water, heritage, socio-economics).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Chapters reviewed and integrated into the Environmental Statement.

tasks.title: Ecology surveys (bats, badgers, great crested newts)
tasks.description: Complete season-critical ecology surveys (bats, badgers, GCN, breeding birds).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Surveys completed within the survey season and accepted.

tasks.title: Archaeology & cultural heritage survey
tasks.description: Carry out archaeological and cultural-heritage desk-based assessment and evaluation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Assessment accepted and mitigation scoped.

tasks.title: Noise & air quality assessment
tasks.description: Produce the noise and air quality assessment to support the EIA.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Report accepted and mitigation identified.

tasks.title: Stage 1 Road Safety Audit
tasks.description: Conduct the Stage 1 Road Safety Audit on the preliminary design.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RSA recommendations responded to and closed out.

tasks.title: Statutory consultation & Design Fix 1
tasks.description: Run statutory consultation and issue Design Fix 1.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Statutory consultation completed and Design Fix 1 issued.

tasks.title: Pavement design to CD 236
tasks.description: Complete the detailed pavement design compliant with CD 236.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design compliant with CD 236 and accepted.

tasks.title: Structures design – overbridge replacement
tasks.description: Complete detailed structures design (overbridge replacement) with independent Category 3 check.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design certified and Category 3 check complete.

tasks.title: Drainage design compliant with CD 527
tasks.description: Complete detailed drainage and SuDS design compliant with CD 527.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design meets CD 527 and has LLFA agreement.

tasks.title: Smart motorway technology design (MIDAS, ERF, HSR)
tasks.description: Design the all-lane-running smart motorway technology (MIDAS, ERF, HSR) and systems architecture.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design meets the all-lane-running smart motorway specification.

tasks.title: Lighting & electrical design to BS 5489
tasks.description: Complete lighting and electrical design compliant with BS 5489.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design compliant with BS 5489 and accepted.

tasks.title: Signs, gantries & variable messaging
tasks.description: Design signs, gantries and variable message signs (VMS) and their foundations.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design accepted by National Highways.

tasks.title: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) chapters – DCO submission
tasks.description: Finalise the EIA and Environmental Statement for DCO submission.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: DCO application accepted for examination.

tasks.title: Draft Order Publication (DCO/TWAO)
tasks.description: Prepare and publish the Draft Order and statutory notices.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Draft Order published in accordance with statutory process.

tasks.title: Public consultation events (statutory)
tasks.description: Run statutory public consultation events following Draft Order publication.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Statutory consultation completed and report published.

tasks.title: Public Inquiry / Examination preparation
tasks.description: Prepare for the Public Inquiry / Examination in Public, including the Statement of Common Ground.
tasks.deliverables: Statement of Common Ground and inquiry proofs
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Examination readiness signed off.

tasks.title: Development Consent Order (DCO) determination
tasks.description: Support the examination and obtain the DCO determination.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: DCO made and sealed.

tasks.title: Land acquisition / CPO negotiation
tasks.description: Negotiate and acquire land and complete CPO/vesting for the scheme extents.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Possession secured for the works.

tasks.title: Utility diversions (gas, water, telecoms, HV)
tasks.description: Design and agree utility diversions (gas, water, telecoms, HV) with the undertakers.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Diversion designs accepted by the undertakers.

tasks.title: Section 278 / street works agreements
tasks.description: Agree Section 278 and street-works agreements with the relevant highway authorities.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: S278 and street-works agreements signed.

tasks.title: Stage 2 Road Safety Audit
tasks.description: Conduct the Stage 2 Road Safety Audit on the detailed design.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RSA recommendations responded to and closed out.

tasks.title: Ecology mitigation (bats, badgers, great crested newts)
tasks.description: Apply for and obtain Natural England mitigation licences and plan season-critical mitigation works.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Natural England licences granted and mitigation sequenced.

tasks.title: Procurement strategy & package schedule
tasks.description: Develop the procurement strategy and package schedule, identifying long-lead items.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Package schedule baselined.

tasks.title: Tender & contractor prequalification
tasks.description: Run prequalification and tender for the main works and key packages.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Contractor list and preferred bidder approved.

tasks.title: Long-lead procurement (structural steel, precast)
tasks.description: Place long-lead orders for structural steel, precast beams, gantries and smart-motorway technology.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Orders placed against the programme with agreed lead times.

tasks.title: Main works contract award & mobilisation
tasks.description: Award the main works contract and mobilise the delivery team.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Contract awarded and mobilisation commenced.

tasks.title: Site establishment & compound set-up
tasks.description: Establish site compounds, access and welfare in readiness for main works.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Compounds operational and accepted.

tasks.title: Traffic management (TM) staging plans
tasks.description: Design TM staging plans reconciling programme, safety and road-user delay.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: TM staging plans accepted.

tasks.title: Construction Sequence & Method Statements
tasks.description: Develop the construction sequence and method statements, including temporary works.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Method statements approved.

tasks.title: Health & safety plan & CDM construction phase plan
tasks.description: Prepare and have accepted the CDM construction-phase plan and health and safety plan.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Plan accepted by the Principal Designer.

tasks.title: Permits to dig & street works permits
tasks.description: Obtain permits to dig and street-works permits for the works.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Permits in place before relevant works.

tasks.title: Night closures planning & lane rental
tasks.description: Plan night closures and agree the lane-rental scheme.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Lane-rental scheme agreed and closure plan accepted.

tasks.title: Enabling works (site clearance, demolition)
tasks.description: Carry out enabling works including site clearance and demolition.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Site clearance accepted.

tasks.title: Earthworks method & materials management plan
tasks.description: Develop the earthworks method and materials management plan (MMP).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: MMP approved.

tasks.title: Ground investigation (GI) across corridor
tasks.description: Carry out construction-phase GI across the corridor to confirm design assumptions.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: GI complete and data validated.

tasks.title: Earthworks bulk excavation & import balance
tasks.description: Execute bulk earthworks excavation and manage the import/export balance.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Earthworks accepted and material balance achieved.

tasks.title: Earthworks compaction & acceptability testing
tasks.description: Test earthworks compaction and acceptability against specification.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Compaction meets specification.

tasks.title: Pavement layers (sub-base to surfacing)
tasks.description: Construct pavement layers from sub-base to binder course.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Layers accepted and levels confirmed.

tasks.title: Structures – foundations & piling
tasks.description: Construct structures foundations and piling to the accepted design.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Piling accepted and recorded.

tasks.title: Concrete & steel bridge works
tasks.description: Construct concrete and structural-steel bridge works for the overbridge replacement.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Structure accepted and Category 3 verified.

tasks.title: Drainage installation (pipes, culverts, attenuation)
tasks.description: Install drainage pipes, culverts and attenuation to the accepted design.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Drainage tested and accepted.

tasks.title: Road restraint systems (VRS) installation
tasks.description: Install road restraint systems (VRS) to the certified system specification.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: VRS installed and certified.

tasks.title: Gantry foundations & erect gantries
tasks.description: Construct gantry foundations and erect gantries to drawing.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Gantries erected to drawing.

tasks.title: Smart motorway technology (MIDAS, ERF, HSR) installation
tasks.description: Install smart-motorway technology (MIDAS, ERF, HSR) and supporting cabling.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ITS installed and powered.

tasks.title: Signs, gantries & variable messaging installation
tasks.description: Install signs and variable message signs on the erected gantries.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Signs installed and tested.

tasks.title: Lighting & electrical to BS 5489
tasks.description: Install lighting columns, ducting and electrical infrastructure to BS 5489.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Lighting installed and circuits tested.

tasks.title: Landscaping & environmental planting
tasks.description: Carry out landscaping and environmental planting to deliver BNG and landscape mitigation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Planting within season and BNG met.

tasks.title: Traffic management (TM) execution & lane closures
tasks.description: Execute TM operations and lane closures safely under live traffic.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: TM compliant and incidents managed.

tasks.title: Night closures execution & lane rental
tasks.description: Execute night closures and manage lane-rental budget.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Closures delivered within lane-rental budget.

tasks.title: Final surfacing & white lining
tasks.description: Lay the surface course and apply white lining within the weather window.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Surface accepted and skid resistance verified.

tasks.title: Winter weather / seasonal works management
tasks.description: Manage winter weather and seasonal constraints during construction.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Weather risks mitigated and logged.

tasks.title: Abnormal loads & access management
tasks.description: Plan and manage abnormal-load deliveries (gantries, beams) and site access.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Abnormal loads delivered safely and logged.

tasks.title: Structural bearings & joints commissioning
tasks.description: Commission and verify structural bearings and expansion joints.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Bearings and joints verified.

tasks.title: Drainage outfall proving
tasks.description: Prove drainage outfalls are free-flowing and connect as designed.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Outfalls proven free-flowing.

tasks.title: Asphalt compaction validation
tasks.description: Validate asphalt compaction against the design and specification.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Compaction validated to specification.

tasks.title: Electrical lighting energisation into operation
tasks.description: Energise lighting and electrical systems into operation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Lighting energised into operation.

tasks.title: Smart motorway technology integration test
tasks.description: Carry out the smart-motorway technology integration test (MIDAS, ERF, HSR).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Integration test passed.

tasks.title: VRS impact certification
tasks.description: Confirm VRS impact certification and acceptance of the installed system.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: VRS impact-tested and accepted.

tasks.title: Traffic trial load & loading check
tasks.description: Carry out the traffic trial load and structural loading check on the new structures.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Load test accepted.

tasks.title: Category 3 / Stage 3 safety audit (DMRB CD 377)
tasks.description: Conduct the Stage 3 Road Safety Audit (DMRB CD 377) on the completed works.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RSA recommendations closed out.

tasks.title: Systems integration & communications test
tasks.description: Test end-to-end systems integration and communications.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Communications verified.

tasks.title: Pre-commissioning checks & snagging
tasks.description: Complete pre-commissioning checks and open the snagging list.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Checks complete and snagging list opened.

tasks.title: Category 3 corrections / snagging
tasks.description: Complete Category 3 corrections and snagging.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Category 3 snags closed.

tasks.title: Final snagging walkdown with National Highways
tasks.description: Conduct the final snagging walkdown with National Highways.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Walkdown signed off.

tasks.title: Spatial safety audit
tasks.description: Carry out the spatial safety audit of the completed works.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Audit findings closed out.

tasks.title: Completion certificate & as-built handover
tasks.description: Issue the completion certificate and hand over the as-built record.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Completion certificate issued and as-builts accepted.

tasks.title: Operations & maintenance manuals
tasks.description: Compile and hand over the operations and maintenance manuals.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Manuals accepted by the maintainer.

tasks.title: Post-opening project evaluation (POPE)
tasks.description: Carry out the post-opening project evaluation and submit the report.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: POPE report submitted.

tasks.title: Defects liability period management
tasks.description: Manage the defects liability period to close-out.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Defects managed to close-out.

tasks.title: Lessons learned & project close-out report
tasks.description: Compile lessons learned and the project close-out report.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Project formally closed.
